author: MiniWarGaming
description:

Which Games Workshop specialist games actually deserve a spot on your shelf?

I’m clearing out my massive Warhammer collection, from Kill Team to Adeptus Titanicus, and making some tough decisions on what to keep. Whether you love the Horus Heresy or Aeronautica Imperialis, I want to know your favorites.

Drop a comment letting me know which specialist games you still play today!
title: What's your favourite Games Workshop specialist game?
